# STS

Issue local session credentials and inspect the resolved caller identity.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `sts` |
| Signing name | `sts` |
| Wire protocol | AWS Query |
| API version | `2011-06-15` |
| Scope | Account and region |
| Execution | Local behavior |
| Selected operations | 5 of 11 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#sts) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- Web identity token signatures are verified only in `identity.mode: verify`, and only RS256; parse mode trusts the claims.
- No MFA, SAML, federation tokens or session tags; AWS proprietary packed-policy compression and PackedPolicySize are not emulated.
- Temporary credentials used to create Lambda functions do not provide a usable runtime secret.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.
